source.snippet: I'm planning to migrate data from one SharePoint Online site to another SharePoint Online site. I need to transfer document libraries, folders, files, metadata, permissions, and version history without losing any data. The source site contains a large amount of business data, so I'm looking for a reliable and secure migration method that minimizes downtime. Has anyone recently performed a SharePoint-to-SharePoint migration? Which tools or methods would you recommend?

problem_statement: IT professionals and admins migrating large SharePoint Online tenants struggle to reliably preserve metadata, permissions, and version history while minimising downtime, and lack clear guidance on trustworthy tooling.
target_segment: IT admins, M365 consultants, and system integrators at SMB-to-enterprise companies running SharePoint Online.
notes: Business data migration is high-stakes and time-sensitive — classic paid-tool territory. Existing players (ShareGate, Metalogix) charge hundreds of dollars per migration. Signal implies willingness to pay for reliability and support. Buyer: IT admin or consultant on a billable engagement.
